offer.summary: We deliver fresh, hand-checked fruit to Austin businesses six mornings a week, with no minimum order and credit for anything that arrives below standard.
offer.cta: Can I drop off a free sample box this week so you can compare quality and price?

segments.name: juice_bars
segments.pitch: Fruit is most of your cost of goods, so ripeness and price matter more to you than to anyone. We deliver ripe-to-blend fruit six mornings a week and credit anything that isn't usable.

segments.name: hotels_catering
segments.pitch: For breakfast buffets and event platters you need fruit that looks perfect on the day. We deliver cut-ready fruit six mornings a week and can scale up for events with 48 hours' notice.

segments.name: grocers
segments.pitch: We supply independent grocers with display-grade fruit in case or half-case quantities, so you can carry more variety without the waste.

segments.name: cafes_bakeries
segments.pitch: A lot of cafes tell us they're stuck between supermarket runs and distributors with big minimums. We deliver small orders of fresh fruit six mornings a week, no minimum.

segments.name: offices
segments.pitch: We run weekly fruit boxes for Austin offices: a simple, healthy perk priced per box, delivered Monday morning, pause any time.

segments.name: restaurants
segments.pitch: We deliver fresh fruit for kitchens and bar programs six mornings a week, with no minimum order - useful as a main supplier or as a reliable backup.

segments.name: schools_childcare
segments.pitch: We deliver ready-to-serve fruit for snack programs on a fixed weekly schedule, with simple invoicing.

segments.name: gyms
segments.pitch: A fruit bowl at the front desk is a cheap member perk. We deliver a weekly box sized to your traffic.

queries: independent grocery store in Austin TX

templates.call:
Call script for {company}:
1. "Hi, this is {sender}. Who looks after your fruit and produce ordering?"
2. "{pitch}"
3. "{cta}"
If busy: ask the best time to call back and the buyer's name/email. Avoid 11am-2pm and 5-8pm (service hours).

landing.headline: Fresh fruit delivered to your business, six mornings a week
landing.subhead: No minimum order. Credit for anything below standard. Serving Austin cafes, juice bars, restaurants, hotels and offices.
bullets: Free sample box before you commit
landing.consent: By submitting you agree to be contacted about this request.
landing.thanks: Thanks - we'll call you within one business day to arrange your sample box.
